stations.name: Base camp
stations.subtitle: Find your feet
stations.instruction: Pull a hand or the torso to test recovery. Pick a station to raise the stakes.

stations.name: The incline
stations.subtitle: Uphill / downhill
stations.instruction: An angled foothold. Pull uphill, downhill, or sideways and watch the ankles work.

stations.name: Broken ground
stations.subtitle: Roll / pitch / recover
stations.instruction: A rolling, banked surface with uneven footing. Small pulls expose the limits of support.

stations.name: Knife edge
stations.subtitle: A very small margin
stations.instruction: A narrow, elevated beam. A sideways pull quickly takes the body outside its support.

stations.name: Islands
stations.subtitle: Mind the gaps
stations.instruction: Offset stepping stones, different heights, and gaps. Guide the torso toward the next island.

stations.name: Sea legs
stations.subtitle: The floor fights back
stations.instruction: The deck rolls and pitches under real contact. Try to stay upright as the tilt builds.

stations.name: Trip wire
stations.subtitle: Steps / barriers / slalom
stations.instruction: Low barriers and offset blocks interrupt corrective steps. Pull the body into the course.
